applies_to: Easy Altivar ATV610 drives on the built-in Modbus serial port, per Communication Parameters file EAV64394 V1.6.
summary: Schneider Electric's Easy Altivar 610 pump and fan drive with Modbus RTU on its built-in serial port. Each parameter has a fixed decimal logical address sent as the holding-register address. This map covers the CiA402 command and status words, frequency and speed references, the main monitors, energy counters, fault and warning codes, I/O states and the Modbus and channel settings needed for network control.

addressing.note: The parameter file gives each logical address in hex and decimal (16#0C81 = 3201); the decimal value goes into the request unchanged. The Modbus serial manual's example reads W3102-W3105 by sending start address 0C1E hex (= 3102) and writes W9001 at 2329 hex, so there is no 40001 offset and no minus 1.

source.title: ATV610 - Communication Parameters (Excel)
source.pages: Zip containing ATV610_Communication_parameters_EAV64394_1.6_IE05.xlsx: sheet 'Parameters' (code, logic address, access, type, unit, factory, range), 'Enumerations', 'Registers'. Modbus manual EAV64395.03 (10/2024): p. 26 CMD bits and command table, pp. 27-28 ETA bits and state table, pp. 39-42 function 3/6/16 examples, pp. 59-61 Add/tbr/tFO/ttO.

notes: Second source: Easy Altivar ATV610 Modbus Manual EAV64395.03 (10/2024), https://download.schneider-electric.com/files?p_Doc_Ref=EAV64395 - addressing examples (read W3102 at 0C1E hex, write W9001 at 2329 hex), settings, the CiA402 sequence and the CMD/ETA bit layout.
Every register in this map is a single 16-bit word; 32-bit values in the parameter file (e.g. run/power-on time counters) are left out because neither document states their word order.
LFR (8502) and RFR (3202) are 0.1 Hz only while CMI bit 9 = 0; with bit 9 = 1 they become a signed value where 32767 = tFr. The parameter file states this in the CMI bit 9 description.
LCR (3204) is left unscaled: the parameter file says 'refer to programming manual', where the current step depends on the drive rating.
ACC/DEC (9001/9002) are raw values; their resolution follows INR (9020): 0 = 0.01 s, 1 = 0.1 s, 2 = 1 s.
Energy is split into 0-999 registers per decade: motor energy = OC4 TWh + OC3 GWh + OC2 MWh + OC1 kWh + OC0 Wh; input energy likewise with IC0-IC4.
Value lists for HMIS, LFT/DP0-DP3, LALR, FR1 (PSA list), CD1, TBR and the stop/fault reactions are copied from the Enumerations sheet.
Registers shown as RW that the file lists as R/WS can only be written while the drive is not running.
Left out: NCR, ITH, AI physical values, PID feedback/reference and SPD because their unit is 'refer to programming manual'; option-card and function-block parameters.

integration.summary: Set Add (6001) to 1-247 and restart the drive, set FR1 to Modbus (164) with CHCF = SIM, then write CMD (8501) = 0006h followed by 000Fh with a non-zero LFR (8502, 0.1 Hz) or LFRD (8602, rpm). Poll ETA (3201), RFR (3202), HMIS (3240) and LFT (7121).
integration.enable: Set [Modbus Address] Add (logical 6001) to 1-247; the factory value 0 (OFF) means the drive does not answer. Speed and format default to 19200 baud, 8-E-1 (tbr 6003, tFO 6004). A new Modbus address takes effect only after the drive is restarted. For combined CiA402 control use [Control Mode] CHCF = [Not separ.] SIM and set [Ref Freq 1 Config] FR1 = Modbus (164); for separate mode use CHCF = SEP with Cd1 = Modbus.
integration.watchdog: [ModbusTimeout] ttO (6005), 0.1-30 s, factory 10 s. If no valid Modbus frame arrives within ttO on a monitored channel, the drive raises [Modbus Com Interruption] SLF1 and reacts per SLL (7010): factory freewheel stop, or ignore, configured stop, fallback speed LFF (7080), speed maintained, ramp stop, fast stop or DC injection.
quirks: Addresses are decimal logical numbers sent as-is (3201 = 0x0C81); do not subtract 1 or add 40001.
CiA402 sequence: 0006h (shutdown) -> Ready to switch on, then 000Fh (enable operation) to run; 0007h disables operation, 0000h disables voltage, 0002h quick stop, 0080h rising edge resets a fault.
Mask ETA with 006Fh to read the state: 0040h switch on disabled, 0021h ready to switch on, 0023h switched on, 0027h operation enabled, 0007h quick stop active, 0008h/0028h fault.
CMD bit 11 is reverse direction by default ([Reverse Assign] rrS = C111); bits 12-15 can be assigned to functions (C112-C115).
setup: Set Add, tbr and tFO in the [Communication] COM- / [Comm parameters] CMP- / [Modbus SL] MSL- / [Modbus Fieldbus] Md1- menu, then restart the drive so the new address is used.
RS-485 trunk: shielded twisted pair plus a common conductor; each line terminator is 120 ohm in series with 1 nF; the master supplies bus polarization.
Write CMD and the reference at least once so the Modbus channel becomes active and monitored.
gotchas: Factory Add = OFF: a brand-new drive is silent on the bus.
Configuration parameters (R/WS) are refused while the motor is running.
CMI bit 1 (save to EEPROM) clears itself, but if CMI is written cyclically the master must write it back to 0; EEPROM life is about 100,000 writes.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
